opinions.text:
Motion for leave to file petition for writ of habeas corpus and for other relief denied. Treating the papers submitted as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.

Probable Jurisdiction Noted. (See No. 699¡ ante, p. 246.)

Certiorari Granted. (See No. 753, ante, p. 240.)

Certiorari Denied. (See also Misc. Nos. 841 and 848, supra.)
